_comment: Copy to config.local.json and fill in. Anything set here overrides the same upper-case name in config.py. Unknown keys are reported and ignored.
_comment2: This file is gitignored. Nothing personal should ever be in config.py.
USER_NAME: your name, spoken in the system prompt and confirmations
CITY: your city, for the briefing's weather line
_comment3: Words the recogniser is biased towards. Put your name, your town, the programs you launch by voice. Without these whisper guesses at proper nouns.
WHISPER_HINT: Jarvis, Maki, Linux, cpu, gpu, ram, terminal, wifi, bluetooth, screenshot
_comment4: The phrase that wakes it. Understood by the recogniser, not matched by a trained model, so any phrase works. Changing it means WAKE_ALIASES in config.py should follow, or the transcript has to match it exactly.
